items.title: picoCTF 2026 – General Skills: Printer Shares
items.summary: TL;DR picoCTF 2026 – General Skills: Printer Shares is a misc challenge from picoCTF. This challenge simulates a scenario where an important file was accidentally sent to a network printer. The goal is to retrieve the file from the printer server. The hints suggest that understanding the SMB (Server Message Block) protocol and using tools such as smbclient or smbutil will be helpful. Overview This challenge simulates a scenario where an important file was accidentally sent to a network printer. The goal is to retrieve the file from the printer server.
